objective: Reduce integer-cent expenses into safe own-name balances with deterministic remainder allocation.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Reduce and destructured records remain current.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Shared-cost accounting is recognizable practical work.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Exact integer allocation and safe dictionaries transfer to aggregation tasks.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Finite cents and nonempty unique split names make the contract teachable.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Prototype collisions and lost cents are material correctness risks.

defects: All boards accumulated into {} so inherited names and __proto__ were unsafe.
Junior used for-of instead of the requested destructured reduce callback.
Empty splits, integer-cent bounds, name identity and input ownership were unspecified.
rationale: Use Object.create(null) in all boards, skeleton, hint and approach; align junior to destructured reduce with an explicit remainder counter. Names are arbitrary bounded case-sensitive strings, including prototype-like names; each nonempty split is unique. Define at most 1000 expenses/100 people, integer amounts through 10^9, safe aggregate cents, unchanged inputs, fresh outputs and an O(n) total-visit model. Probe own __proto__/constructor/toString, zero amounts and distinct spaced/case-sensitive/numeric names, integer conservation, 100000 share visits and 10^12 aggregate credit. Prototype/key order is deliberately ungraded.

objective: Parse one well-formed CSV record with for-of quote-state tracking, escaped quotes, embedded line breaks and literal spaces.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: CSV remains a current interchange format.
relevanceRationale.transferable: State transitions and escaped delimiters transfer widely.

defects: Junior used indexed for and senior regex matches instead of requested for-of characters.
Malformed records and physical versus logical line boundaries were unspecified.
No upper bound, output freshness or portable string-accumulation cost model was stated.
rationale: Align junior/senior to direct character for-of with previous-quote/state tracking. State the valid quoted/unquoted grammar, no exterior record delimiter, embedded CR/LF in quoted fields, literal whitespace, Unicode and 10000-code-unit bound. Invalid input has no specified behavior. Use a conservative quadratic accumulation bound without an engine-independent copying claim. Add escaped quote plus CRLF/emoji/empty/space fields, fresh repeated arrays, a maximum-length field and 10000 empty fields. RFC 4180 informs quoting rules, while the exercise explicitly retains its existing empty/trailing-field contract.

defects: Opaque values, set-to-identical step behavior and operation bounds were implicit.

rationale: Retain all correct supplied implementations. Add direct boolean tests for undefined versus object identities, NaN and signed zero, same-value steps, branch clearing, and 3333 set/undo/redo cycles plus one current read (10000 calls).

objective: Return an independent closure counter whose increment/reset return exactly the same object and whose value read is pure.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Closures and fluent APIs remain current.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: A chainable counter is a useful small state exercise.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Private per-instance state and receiver identity transfer to larger APIs.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: The bounded factory contract fits the stated closure lesson.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Exact return identity and independent reads prevent plausible incorrect APIs.

defects: Senior taught private-class fields instead of the stated closure focus.
Chaining worked with copied wrappers, but exact return-object identity was not asserted.
No maximum method-call sequence or explicit pure value read existed.
rationale: Replace senior class with a factory closure and named counter object. Specify increment-by-one, exact counter identity on increment/reset, separate instance objects/state, pure value reads, receiver-bound use, and 10000-call bound. Add same-object predicates, independent second counter and 9994 increments within the per-instance call limit. Factory/method work and auxiliary space are constant under the bounded numeric model; detached method semantics remain outside the task.
